module: 'caution' component shared by the English styles: texts of the three warning levels ('care', 'caution', 'double caution') and colors of the matching visual notes (background, outline, icon, text) taken from compositors/helpers/colors.

levelVisuals.desc: Colors per level: {colorBg, colorStroke, colorNoteIcon, colorNoteText}. Level 1 yellow on black, levels 2 and 3 red on black.

notes: The module returns the table {levels, levelVisuals} directly (no M).
visualCompositor picks the 'doubleCaution' icon for level >= 3, otherwise 'caution'.
